overview: AgriMarket is a fully responsive agricultural marketplace platform inspired by Blinkit on mobile and Amazon on web — covering product discovery, selling, dashboards, trust & safety, and learning resources for farmers, buyers, and experts.
features: Mobile-first card feeds with voice search (Blinkit/Swiggy style)
Web sidebar with parametric filters and grid/list toggle (Amazon/Flipkart style)
Home with Seasonal Pulse, Trusted Sellers Map, and Market Trends
Discover section with Seeds, Produce, Equipment categories and saved searches
Sell/List with 90-sec Quick List FAB, listing wizard, bulk CSV upload, and contract builder
Seller Dashboard with analytics, inventory forecasting, messages, and wallet
Trust & Safety with KYC verification, dispute center, and compliance reports
Resources with planting calendar, market prices, equipment guides, community, and learning hub
Role toggle (Buyer/Seller/Expert) that personalizes dashboards and navigation instantly
Rich hardcoded sample data: 15+ farmer profiles, 50+ listings, 10+ courses, 5+ educators
